mission: Collector v1 S3: collector account tables (one additive migration 3b7d9c1a5e20) and the dark /me API behind COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED (off). PLAN §B1/§C/§H S3. Staging only; no collector release.

impacts.reason: Additive migration 3b7d9c1a5e20 (parent 6c2242f6f439) creates five empty tables: collection_entries, collection_entry_events, watchlist_entries, user_preferences, collection_value_points. user_id FKs CASCADE, card_print_id FKs RESTRICT. No existing table, column, constraint or row changes. Downgrade refuses non-empty tables. app/accounts is not imported by app.models, so neither collector reaches it (test_accounts_import_graph.py; scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py: 0 changed runtime inputs for snkrdunk and yuyutei).

Dark /me API (/me/collection, /me/collection/value, /me/watchlist, /me/preferences, /me/export, DELETE /me). COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is read in accounts/config.py, off by default and unset on staging, so every /me route answers 404 before authentication. Valuation reads archived Market Index values from receipted days only; unpriced is never 0; Yuyu-Tei sale and struck prices never value a collection. No pricing methodology, Market Index or Market Value change. DELETE /me also removes the user's SET NULL saved_views/search_history rows and FK-less file_jobs rows and files. Legacy copy CLI is dry run by default. No settings.py, app/models/** or requirements change.

Tenant isolation, flag-off 404, cascade and explicit deletion (schema-discovered user_id columns/FKs on Postgres), constraints, coverage math, unpriced != 0, Yuyu sale exclusion, struck-price non-substitution, downgrade refusal, collector import graph.

Test-only: mint the 60-second admin actor assertions inside the test instead of at collection time, so a suite that reaches them more than 60 s after collection does not fail. Expiry and assertions unchanged.
Operations doc: tables, endpoints, flag, deletion semantics, legacy copy CLI and rollback.

resources.name: Staging Postgres: five new empty tables (migration 3b7d9c1a5e20 applied before this PR leaves draft via documented alembic upgrade, lock_timeout 10s)

routes: /me/collection, /me/collection/value, /me/watchlist, /me/preferences, /me/export, DELETE /me: new, 404 while COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is off (staging: unset). No existing route changes.
dependencies: archived Market Index values and delivery receipts (read only)
impact.deployment_impact: API redeploys on merge through its normal trigger. No web, collector watch path or collector-imported module changes, so no collector build or rollout; collector_services is empty. The migration is additive and applied before this PR leaves draft, so the verifier sees revision 3b7d9c1a5e20.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the /me routes (already dark). Then, while the tables are still empty, alembic downgrade 6c2242f6f439 drops the five tables; the migration refuses if any row exists (dropping data would be a separate RED decision).
recovery.trigger: migration error or lock timeout; verifier failure; any /me route answering other than 404 while the flag is off; any change in Market Value, Market Index or public page responses
recovery.backup: Staging Postgres volume backup younger than 24 h confirmed immediately before the upgrade (id and time in the S3 handoff). The migration creates empty tables only and modifies no existing row.

verification.observation_window: Delivery receipt with API at the merge, revision 3b7d9c1a5e20 and no collector rollout; read-only check that the five tables exist and are empty and that /me routes answer 404.
